name: Hamas Attack on Southern Israel
target: Kibbutzim, military bases, and Nova music festival in southern Israel
description: Hamas launched a large-scale surprise attack from Gaza into southern Israel, killing approximately 1,200 people and taking 251 hostages. This triggered Israel's ground invasion of Gaza.

name: Israel Launches Ground Invasion of Gaza
casualties: Tens of thousands killed over following months
description: Israel launched a ground invasion of the Gaza Strip, beginning in the north and progressively expanding. The campaign caused massive civilian casualties and near-total destruction of infrastructure.

name: Gaza Ceasefire Agreement Takes Effect
target: Cessation of hostilities and phased hostage-prisoner exchange
casualties: N/A (over 46,000 Palestinians killed by this date)
description: A ceasefire agreement brokered by Qatar, Egypt, and the US took effect, establishing phased hostage-prisoner exchanges and partial Israeli withdrawal. The agreement has been repeatedly violated since.

name: Gaza Disease Outbreak: 9,300+ Chickenpox Cases
casualties: 9,300+ cases; indirect deaths from collapsed healthcare system
description: Over 9,300 chickenpox cases were recorded across 130 health facilities in Gaza, reflecting the near-total collapse of the healthcare system. Only 3 hospitals remain fully functional in the entire territory.

name: Hamas Announces Civilian Governance Handover
parties: NCAG (National Committee for Administration of Gaza)
description: Hamas announced via Cairo that it would hand over civilian governance in Gaza to the NCAG, but without a disarmament timeline. Israel rejected the move as insufficient for its security demands.

name: EU Announces 900M Euro Gaza Recovery Fund
description: The European Union announced 900 million euros in funding for Gaza early recovery, the largest single international financial commitment to post-ceasefire reconstruction.

name: West Bank Settler Violence Wave: Tell/Nablus
target: Tell village near Nablus; spread to 5 towns across West Bank
description: A settler raid and shootout in Tell village near Nablus killed 4 Palestinians and 2 Israelis, triggering the most intense settler violence wave of 2026. Over the following days, settlers attacked across 5 towns, and 70+ Palestinians were detained in sweeping IDF raids.

name: Settler Revenge Attacks: Mosques Burned in Qusra, Kur
target: Rahma Mosque in Qusra, mosque in Kur, homes in Beit Furik
description: In retaliation for the Tell incident, settlers burned the Rahma Mosque in Qusra and set fire to a mosque in Kur. Homes were burned in Beit Furik. Four illegal outposts were established by settlers during the violence.

name: Netanyahu Rejects US 15-Point Gaza Roadmap
target: US-proposed phased withdrawal and disarmament plan
description: Netanyahu rejected a US-led 15-point roadmap for Gaza, declaring Israel would not withdraw until Hamas was genuinely disarmed. The rejection was described by analysts as threatening endless war and undermining the ceasefire framework.

name: Israeli Airstrikes Kill 3 Including Child in Gaza
casualties: 3 killed including a 4-year-old child, multiple wounded
description: Israeli airstrikes killed 3 people including a 4-year-old child across multiple locations in Gaza. Netanyahu threatened intensification of operations over kite launches from Gaza into Israeli territory.

name: Strikes Hit Water Plant, Mosque, UNICEF Warehouse
target: Water plant, mosque, and UNICEF warehouse in Bureij, Deir el-Balah, Khan Younis
description: Israeli strikes hit civilian infrastructure including a water treatment plant, a mosque, and a UNICEF warehouse storing nutrition supplies for children and pregnant women. Seven people were killed including two children.

name: IDF Demolishes Tell Shooter's Family Home
target: Home of Farouq Ramadan in Tell village
description: The IDF demolished the family home of Farouq Ramadan, identified as the Palestinian shooter in the July 24 Tell incident, as a punitive measure. Punitive home demolitions are considered collective punishment under international law.
